title: Talking to an Insurance Agent
meta: B2 · 约 280 词 · 场景：咨询家庭医疗保险与理赔

lines.en: Thanks for coming in. So you're looking at health cover for the whole family?
lines.zh: 谢谢您过来。您是想给全家买医疗保险，对吧？

lines.en: Yes. My company plan only covers me, so I want something for my wife and our son.
lines.zh: 对。公司的保险只保我一个人，我想给太太和儿子也买一份。

lines.en: This family plan covers hospital stays, surgery, and specialist visits, both here and in Malaysia.
lines.zh: 这个家庭计划保住院、手术和专科门诊，新加坡和马来西亚都保。

lines.en: **What's the deductible, and how much would we still have to pay ourselves?**
lines.zh: 免赔额是多少？我们自己还要付多少？

lines.en: The ==deductible== is two thousand dollars a year. After that, there's ten percent ==co-payment==, __capped at__ three thousand.
lines.zh: 免赔额每年两千元。超过后自付百分之十，封顶三千元。

lines.en: So the most we'd pay in a bad year is five thousand. What's the ==premium==?
lines.zh: 那情况最糟的一年，我们最多付五千。保费是多少？

lines.en: For the three of you, around two hundred and sixty dollars a month.
lines.zh: 你们三个人，每月大概两百六十元。

lines.en: My son had asthma when he was a baby. Would that be ==excluded==?
lines.zh: 我儿子婴儿时期有过哮喘。这个会被除外吗？

lines.en: It may be, as a ==pre-existing condition==. We'd need his medical records to __make a decision__.
lines.zh: 有可能，属于既往病症。我们需要看他的病历才能决定。

lines.en: Now, a lot of families also add our savings plan. It __builds up__ cash value for your son's education.
lines.zh: 另外，很多家庭会加上我们的储蓄计划，可以为孩子教育攒现金价值。

lines.en: **I'd rather keep insurance and savings separate. Let's focus on the health plan for now.**
lines.zh: 我更想把保险和储蓄分开。现在先专注医疗险吧。

lines.en: Fair enough. Can I ask how quickly you'd like to sign up?
lines.zh: 可以理解。请问您打算多快投保？

lines.en: Not today. Could you send me the full policy ==wording== so I can read the fine print?
lines.zh: 今天不签。能把完整的保单条款发给我吗？我想看看细则。

lines.en: Sure, I'll email it tonight, along with a summary of the benefits.
lines.zh: 当然，今晚就发邮件给您，附上保障摘要。

lines.en: Thanks. And if we do need to ==claim==, how does it work? Do we pay first and get ==reimbursed==?
lines.zh: 谢谢。如果真要理赔，流程是怎样的？是先自己付钱再报销吗？

lines.en: At our panel hospitals, we pay them directly. Elsewhere, you __submit the bills__ in the app within ninety days.
lines.zh: 在我们的合作医院，我们直接跟医院结算。其他医院的话，九十天内在应用里提交账单。

lines.en: And is there a ==waiting period== before the cover starts?
lines.zh: 保障生效前有等待期吗？

lines.en: Thirty days for illness, but accidents are covered from day one.
lines.zh: 疾病有三十天等待期，意外从第一天起就保。

lines.en: **That's helpful. I'll go through it with my wife and get back to you next week.**
lines.zh: 很有帮助。我跟太太一起看看，下周给你答复。

gist.q: 这份家庭医疗险的自付部分怎么算？
gist.a: 每年免赔额两千元，之后自付百分之十，封顶三千元，最坏一年最多付五千元。

gist.q: 儿子的哮喘会有什么影响？
gist.a: 可能被当作既往病症除外，需要看病历才能决定。

gist.q: 顾问推销储蓄计划时「你」怎么回应的？最后怎么收尾？
gist.a: 说想把保险和储蓄分开，先只谈医疗险；今天不签，要完整条款回去和太太商量，下周答复。

prompts.q: 你想给全家买一份旅游保险，下个月回国过年。打电话问保不保航班延误、孩子生病看急诊，以及丢行李怎么理赔。
prompts.ref: Hi, we're flying to China next month with our three-year-old, and I'm looking at your family travel plan. Does it cover flight delays, and from how many hours? If my son gets sick and needs to see a doctor there, is that covered? And if a bag goes missing, what documents would I need to make a claim?
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我们下个月要带三岁的孩子回中国，我在看你们的家庭旅游险。航班延误保吗？延误几个小时起算？如果儿子在那边生病要看医生，保不保？如果行李丢了，理赔需要哪些材料？

prompts.q: 你的理赔申请被拒了，理由是既往病症，但你认为这次就诊和以前的病无关。打电话给保险公司提出复议。
prompts.ref: Hi, I'm calling about a claim that was rejected last week. The letter says it's a pre-existing condition, but I don't think that's right. My son saw the doctor for an ear infection, which has nothing to do with his asthma. Could you review the claim again? I can send a letter from his doctor if that helps.
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我打电话是关于上周被拒的一笔理赔。信里说属于既往病症，但我觉得不对。我儿子这次看的是耳朵感染，跟他的哮喘没关系。能重新审核一下吗？需要的话我可以提供医生的证明信。

words.ex: A higher deductible means a lower monthly premium.
There's a small co-payment for each clinic visit.
Our car insurance premium went up this year.
Dental care is excluded from this plan.
Most plans don't cover pre-existing conditions straight away.
Always read the policy wording, not just the brochure.
You can claim for the taxi if your flight is cancelled.
My company reimburses me for the phone bill.
There's a thirty-day waiting period for illness.
